Собственная метрика создаётся декораторо: A custom metric is created with the ``metric`` decorator from ``hydrometrics.core.base``. The decorator takes the name, the direction of improvement, the bounds of the values, a reference and a formula, and the flags ``supports_weight`` and ``supports_axis`` tell whether the function supports weights and an axis. The wrapper takes care of input checks, the missing-value policy, weights, ``reduction`` and the packing of the result, so the kernel receives ready numpy arrays.

От :ref:`metric-nse` метрика отличается: regNSE differs from :ref:`metric-nse` in three ways: the values are ranked, so the order in time is lost; the benchmark is the duration curve of the regime, not the mean; the sums are pooled over years. An incomplete year fills only the first ranks and the remaining ordinates do not enter the sums. There is a single rule for 366 days: when a leap year is present, ranks 365 and 366 (the two smallest values) are averaged to give 365 ranks.
Это же правило применяется к кривой режи: The same rule applies to the regime curve: for a record with a leap year the 366 calendar-day means are sorted in descending order and ranks 365 and 366 are averaged (ranks, not calendar days). The rule is the same for the annual curves and the regime curve.
Метрика сравнивает распределения расходо: The metric compares the distribution of discharge within a year, not hydrographs in time. In the example with simulated values randomly permuted within each year ``regNSE = 0.9057`` at ``NSE = -1.04``: a model with the wrong flood phase can score high. regNSE does not detect a phase error; use :ref:`metric-nse` or :ref:`metric-kge_2012` for that.
Знаменатель regNSE это отклонение годовы: The regNSE denominator is the deviation of the annual duration curves from the regime curve, and on a river with a stable regime it is small. A constant 15 % overestimate gives ``NSE = 0.9675`` but ``regNSE = -42.17``. The metric is stricter than NSE toward bias and volume; compare it with :ref:`metric-pbias`.

Нормировки ``range`` и ``iqr`` в ``nrmse: The ``range`` and ``iqr`` normalisations of ``nrmse`` ignore the weights. ``r2`` gives 1 for all-zero weights whereas ``nse`` gives NaN.
По умолчанию опорой ``crpss`` служит сре: By default the reference of ``crpss`` is the mean of the same sample, so the score is in-sample; with a pronounced seasonal cycle it overstates skill. These functions have no ``fair`` parameter (decision of the author).
